[Council File 26-1200-S43]
Communication from the Mayor relative to the reappointment of Ms. Lisa Waltz Morocco to the West Los Angeles Area Planning Commission for the term ending June 30, 2031. Ms. Waltz Morocco’s current term expired on June 30, 2026.
